design_system.theme: A printed battlefield field manual: warm paper, hard ink borders, hazard labels, offset shadows, and a CSS-only top-down tank schematic. The direction is editorial and tactical rather than a generic dark gaming landing page.
design_system.font_strategy: Use a system condensed display stack for poster-like headings, a system sans-serif stack for readable body copy, and a system monospace stack for labels, controls, IDs, and verification notes. No remote font dependency.
responsive_rules: At 1440px, use a centered 1180px content shell, a two-column hero, three-column topic cards, and full horizontal navigation.
At 768px, stack the hero visual below the copy, change three-column grids to two columns, and keep touch targets at least 42px high.
At 375px, hide the secondary header navigation, use one-column content, stack CTA groups, simplify timeline columns, and preserve at least 12px outer gutters without horizontal overflow.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and retain visible keyboard focus outlines for links and buttons.
